summary: Iteration 6 tested the new DELETE /api/masters/{kind}/{id} endpoint (hard-delete vs soft-deactivate) and the corresponding trash icons on brand tiles, dealer cards and supplier cards. All 14 backend pytest cases passed. Frontend Playwright flow confirmed the three delete data-testids exist, dialog auto-accepts, the item disappears without a page refresh, and clicking the trash on a brand tile does NOT navigate into the brand detail (stopPropagation works). DB reset back to empty at end of run as requested.
critical_code_review_comments: DELETE /api/masters/{kind}/{id} correctly branches on references: brands check active products, dealers/suppliers check transactions.
GET /api/bootstrap now filters {'active': {'$ne': False}} — archived masters correctly hidden.
/api/ledger still queries the raw dealers/suppliers collections (no active filter) so historical party_name still resolves for archived parties — verified.

Minor: when a brand is archived, its products are not auto-deactivated. They remain in /api/bootstrap.products with brand_id pointing at an archived brand. Stock/dashboard/ledger still work because they look brands up by id, but UI product lists may show orphan-branded products. Not a bug per spec ('expected'), but noting for future cleanup.
DELETE handler does not distinguish inactive-vs-active existence — deleting an already-archived record will hard-delete it. Acceptable but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests use TEST_-prefixed masters and clean up implicitly via /api/admin/reset in the final test. UI test seeded UI_TestBrand/UI_TestDealer/UI_TestSupplier via API and then called /api/admin/reset at the end, restoring the empty-canvas state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is currently empty (post /api/admin/reset). test_master_delete.py is idempotent and self-cleaning (last test calls /api/admin/reset). Reuse it for regression on any future changes to masters/products/transactions.
